exhibits.title: The five questions a new chain asks, answered
exhibits.subtitle: Answer, deciding evidence and how sure we are · desk research to Oct 2026
rows: How big is the channel, and is it growing?
Small, fast-growing: chain convenience stores take ~0.25% of retail goods sales; small-format stores tripled since 2019
9,671 tracked small-format stores in 2026 vs 3,007 in 2019 [Q&Me 2026]
How much site supply is left?
Little in Ho Chi Minh City; announced plans already claim half to all of the 2030 base-case growth
GS25 targets 700 by 2027 [B-Company Mar 2025]; FamilyMart 300-1,000 [FamilyMart Sep 2026]
Where is it saturated, contested or open?
Saturated: HCMC. Contested: Hanoi core. Open: the northern ring and the central coast
2.3 chain stores per million people outside the two cities [Kira estimates]
A food-led 100-150 m² store between the two; pure convenience does not cover rent at today's sales
Break-even ~VND 28-38 m a day vs ~VND 24-26 m observed [Kira estimates]
Which tier first, and what is a no-go?
Hanoi townships plus Hai Phong; stop if pilots sit below VND 22 m a day at month 9
Stage-gated plan, USD 6-8 m to the pilot decision [Kira estimates]
